segments.he: לֹא פָּחוֹת וְלֹא יוֹתֵר. תָּנָא: לֹא פָּחוֹת — מִפְּנֵי שֶׁמַּרְבֶּה, וְלֹא יוֹתֵר — מִפְּנֵי שֶׁמְּמַעֵט.
segments.en: We learned in the mishna: One may measure a Shabbat limit only with a rope fifty cubits long, «not less and not more. It was taught» in the Tosefta: «No less, because» a shorter rope improperly «increases» the Shabbat limit, as the rope is likely to be stretched. «And no more, because» a longer rope «reduces» the limit, as the rope is likely to sag due to its weight.
